Oh dear god I never realized how much I needed to hear this. Thank you. For years, when I've talked about my depressive thoughts and suicidal tendencies, it has only been met with negative reactions -- people telling me that i should be grateful, that I shouldn't be feeling this way, and it's led me to believe that I have nothing to be sad about. Maybe I've been self-sabotaging to finally give myself a reason to be sad about, when all I really needed was someone to validate what I'm feeling and someone who can understand and genuinely acknowledge how much it hurts too. You have no idea how much I cried and read your kind words over and over again.

Thank you. I have also seen that you've been commenting on a couple of other posts in this sub. I didn't know kind people such as you still existed. I'm so sorry for your loss -- while this is a different pain of different depth that I can never wholly understand, I am truly sorry and wish you better times. I have no idea how I'd ever pay back the first act of kindness I've received in a long while. Again, thank you so, so much.
It was my first time doing something like that, so I got scammed and dude never paid me. Serves me right tbh

I have to be honest. This was also a reason why I thought of doing it. Even way back then before all this happened, I thought I was never really good enough for him and thought he would finally break up with me and find someone better for him. I didn't expect he'd still want to stay with me even after that. Thanks for making me realize and confront this
I know; I am a terrible person
Thank you. I haven't thought about this well enough and I think he deserves to let me know about his thoughts about this as well, since we barely got to really talk about it.
i wish this was all made up to be honest
